profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: To ship world class products and services using state-of-the-art technologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed content key systems for Apple Music DRM and download/streaming slots. Integrated with
FairPlay, iCloud, and Family Accounts using Oracle, Voldemort, Java, and WebObject.
• Developed and maintained Apple Pay Wallet features: enrollment, token switching, and merchant
token migration.
• Contributed to Payment systems integrations like WeChat Pay, AliPay, and Vision Pro; implemented
fraud detection. Managed store credit limits compliance, Stackable payment methods, pluggable
payment methods, payment lifecycle, commerce event publishing using protobuf and Kafka.
• GDPR compliance eﬀorts for PII reporting using Docker, Vagrant, SideCar, and Amazon SWF.
• Automated unit and integration testing; implemented Splunk/Hubble alerts and reporting.
